control_objective: Maintain a complete AI use-case inventory with ownership purpose and status
iso_iec_42001_theme: AI management system scope and inventory

control_objective: Classify AI risk before production use
evidence: Risk assessment; tier rationale; legal review when applicable

control_objective: Require documented human oversight for consequential use cases
evidence: Oversight plan; workflow evidence; override records

control_objective: Test AI systems for quality bias security and privacy before approval
nist_ai_600_1_alignment: Confabulation; Harmful Bias; Data Privacy; Information Security
eu_ai_act_lens: Testing accuracy robustness and risk management
evidence: Evaluation plan; test results; issue log

control_objective: Apply data minimization access control and retention limits
evidence: Data-flow map; access reviews; retention settings; DLP evidence

control_objective: Perform third-party AI due diligence and change governance
evidence: Vendor assessment; contract clauses; change notices; exit plan

control_objective: Maintain model or system documentation and traceability
evidence: Model card; logs; version history; approvals

control_objective: Monitor deployed AI for drift incidents complaints and policy violations
evidence: Dashboards; sampled outputs; complaint log; risk review minutes

control_objective: Operate an AI incident response and reauthorization process
iso_iec_42001_theme: Nonconformity corrective action and continual improvement
evidence: Incident record; containment evidence; root cause; corrective action; reapproval

control_objective: Retire AI systems and revoke access when business need ends
evidence: Retirement ticket; data disposition evidence; access revocation
